scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && npm run dev --workspace @settlement/playground
scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @settlement/playground && npm run build --workspace @settlement/openfl-probe
scripts.build:packages: npm run build:core && npm run build --workspace @settlement/map-scene && npm run build --workspace @settlement/renderer-openfl && npm run build --workspace @settlement/renderer-canvas && npm run build --workspace @settlement/renderer-svg
scripts.test:p3:browser: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @settlement/playground && playwright test --config playwright.p3.config.ts
scripts.test:p4: npm run build:packages && node --test tests/core/*.test.mjs tests/p3/*.test.mjs tests/p4/*.test.mjs
scripts.test:p4:browser: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @settlement/playground && playwright test --config playwright.p4.config.ts
scripts.test:p5: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @settlement/playground && playwright test --config playwright.p5.config.ts
scripts.benchmark:p5: npm run build:packages && npm run build --workspace @settlement/playground && node scripts/benchmark-p5.mjs
